explication: This repository documents a catalog of CloudStream extensions spanning on-demand video, live streams, and audiobooks. The documented workflow is to add the repository in CloudStream, choose an extension, and have that extension browse an external site and fetch media. The supplied tree contains only logos, not extension code or a manifest, so implementation paths and internal call wiring cannot be verified; repository nodes therefore have null paths.
